name: kata-tts
description: Vietnamese voice-overs and voice-synced videos in KATA TTS: write scripts, design video templates live in production, generate scene voices and export MP4.

interface.longDescription: Write Vietnamese voice scripts, design reusable video templates directly in your KATA TTS account, generate a voice for every scene with the timing fitted automatically, and export the video to Google Drive.
defaultPrompt: Design a 9:16 KATA TTS video template for a coffee shop promo with karaoke captions.
Write a 45-second script about saving money and build a KATA TTS video project from it.
Generate the missing scene voices of my latest KATA TTS video and fit the timing.
